heading: Today
text: A few morning clouds, then mostly sunny skies. Highs in the 50s, nearing 60 in the warmer valleys. Light and variable wind.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear. Lows from the mid-20s to near 30, mid-30s along Lake Champlain. Calm wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Mostly sunny. Highs from the mid 50s to near 60 north, in the low to mid 60s south. Calm wind.
